evidence: The death-at-arrival event is duplicated: “At around 19:44, [PERSON_A] was transported by ambulance to [INSTITUTION_A] and died around the time of arrival at the hospital.” and “It is recorded that [PERSON_A] was transported by ambulance to [INSTITUTION_A] at around 19:44 but died around the time of arrival at the hospital.”

The final text states both that [PERSON_A] died around the time of hospital arrival after transport at approximately 19:44 and that [PERSON_A] died at approximately 20:20, creating an unresolved timing inconsistency.
issues: F006 and F008 duplicate substantially the same transport-and-death fact.

The stated death times are potentially inconsistent: death around hospital arrival after 19:44 transport versus death at around 20:20. The final text preserves both without resolving or clearly attributing the discrepancy.
